one_line: A real morning problem, then ordering, the printed page and the child carrying the book, in one testimonial arc.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 handheld: a woman outdoors speaks to the lens, hands moving. Subtitles "התחלנו" (0:00), "השנה" (0:01), "ללכת" (0:02). 0:03 split screen of two takes of a crying boy; "צרחות" (0:04), "ודרמה" (0:05).
q1_hook.why: A parent talks to the lens at 0:00 and names a lived problem, a hard start at gan (H4, H1, K6). Voice and subtitle start together (H6). The crying boy at 0:03 shows it. The book is not seen until 0:11, so the value is clear only by about 0:18 (H2).

beats.what: She speaks to the lens outdoors; "התחלנו", "השנה", "ללכת"
beats.why: A face and a first-person problem at once

beats.what: Split screen of two takes of a crying boy; "צרחות", "ודרמה"
beats.why: Shows the drama in two clips side by side

beats.what: On a sofa in an orange blouse: "כמעט והתייאשתי", "ואז חברה"; a friend ordered a book
beats.why: The turn: a friend's tip, told as a story

beats.what: A small phone screen recording, lower left; "נכנסתי לאתר", "בסיפור של הגן", "העליתי"
beats.why: Shows the ordering steps while she talks

beats.what: She holds up a printed page of a boy at a wooden door and points; "ודומה לבן"
beats.why: The printed result and "looks like him"

beats.what: A boy holds a rainbow-door book; pages flip: blocks, a robot, a puzzle; "אפשר גם להוסיף"
beats.why: Extra personal objects in the story

beats.what: Back on the sofa, then mother and son read; the back cover shows a round photo and name
The boy climbs gan steps hugging the book, a cracker in hand; "מאז", "לומיבוק", "שלנו נראים", "לגמרי"

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None asked in the video. The caption opens with "זוכרים את הדרמת גן עיריה שהיתה לנו?" to existing followers, a rhetorical question, not an invitation to answer.
q2_flow.why: Problem, a friend's tip, ordering, the printed page, the boy carrying the book to gan: a clear arc with the payoff last (K2, R4). New clips every 2 to 4 s keep it moving (R3, E2). The 0:11 to 0:22 talking head with a tiny overlay is the slowest stretch (R3).

q3_cta.what: None in the video or the caption. The site is named in speech (transcript, 0:06 to 0:11 and 0:15) and subtitled "לומיבוק" at 0:16 and 0:40. Caption: no link, code, comment word or ask; last line "בשיתוף @lumebookai".
q3_cta.why: A convinced viewer has no next step: no link, code, comment word or "link in bio" (C6, C3 not used). The brand is named, so someone could search for it. Free of engagement bait (C2), which suits a story but leaves the conversion to chance.

q4_shown.what: A crying boy (0:03); a small phone screen recording of the site, lower left, 0:11 to 0:22; a printed page held up (0:22); a boy with a rainbow-door book (0:27); pages flipped (0:29 to 0:35); reading with mother (0:37); gan steps (0:39). No price.
q4_shown.why: A parent's first-hand story (S6) shows the personalising steps on a screen (S8) and the printed page she says looks like him; the real boy and the page never share a frame (S2 partly). The overlay is too small to read (F4). The child's face and name appear together (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 11 shots in 42 s, about 3.9 s each, straight cuts; a split screen at 0:03; an 11 s phone-screen overlay; faster cuts in the last 6 s. Word-by-word subtitles change about every second. Ends on the boy on the steps.
q5_edit.why: A cut at 0:03 and a new room at 0:06 give early energy (E1, E2). Short subtitles carry the voice for muted viewers (E4, T2), but the overlay and subtitles crowd the lower half at 0:13 (T2). It ends on the payoff (E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother's story of a hard start at gan and the personalised gan book that changed the mornings. Serves parents of children starting gan.
q6_topic.why: A real milestone worry told first-person, with a "this happened to us" tone (K6). Starting gan is a buying moment (K7), and the story has a character, a turn and a payoff (K2). "Our mornings look different" is a personal, modest claim (K4).

q7_filmed.what: A handheld selfie outdoors for the hook; a steady selfie on a sofa in warm window light; a split screen of two clips; top-down pages on a patterned cloth; handheld clips of the boy at home and on the gan steps.
q7_filmed.why: A face to the lens in warm light feels like a friend talking (F6, H8, F7). Top-down page flips and the page held up fill the frame (F5, F4). The overlay covers a third of the lower frame; subtitles at 76% height sit in the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles, no box, one to three words per card, changing about every second, centred at about 76% of the frame height: "התחלנו" (0:00), "צרחות" (0:04, larger), "ודרמה" (0:05), "כמעט והתייאשתי" (0:06), "לומיבוק בחרתי" (0:16), "ודומה לבן" (0:24), "אפשר גם להוסיף" (0:28), "מאז" (0:39), "לומיבוק" (0:40), "שלנו נראים" (0:41), "לגמרי" (0:42). No headline card, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "זוכרים את הדרמת גן עיריה שהיתה לנו?". About 60 words: the child's name, the book "הגן החדש", a delight line, a "many different stories" line, no hashtags, no question or CTA, and "בשיתוף @lumebookai" last.
q8_text.why: Subtitles of the full speech work muted (T1) and stay short (T2), but sit at about 76% of the frame, inside the bottom 35% (T4). The caption opens with a follower-directed question, has no keywords or hashtags beyond the book title (T7), and the partnership line is last (T8).

weak_points: No CTA, link or code; the website overlay is too small to read; subtitles in the bottom 35%; the hook shot in another place and outfit; no hashtags; disclosure last; the child's name and face together.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with a parent's problem line, then a screen recording of the order at readable size and a page held to the lens, and end with one CTA.
not_verified: Whether the outdoor clip and the sofa clip are the same woman (they look the same); the book's price and whether two books appear (a gan story and a rainbow-door cover); music (cannot hear); the relationship between @lumebookai and the coauthor lumebook.il. The brand is subtitled "לומיבוק" and written so in the caption, not the project's spelling; quoted exactly. The machine transcript misreads the first line; subtitles were used. Correction to src/coded: the overlay screen recording sits at about 33% width in the lower left.
